Write the planning summary naming the goal, the scope and the capacity
Share the published page with the team, the Tech Lead plus dependent team leads
Done when the summary reaches them
verify: Open the team space in Confluence
Pass when the posted summary for the sprint is seen

steps.title: Verify each committed item transitioned before sprint start in Jira
sop: Open each committed item's workflow history in Jira
Read the sprint-assignment transition timestamp
Confirm every timestamp precedes the sprint start
Done when every committed item transitioned before sprint start
verify: Trace the workflow history in Jira
Pass when no committed item transitioned after sprint start

steps.title: Raise an AGILE-Exception for any item committed without approval in Jira
sop: Compare the committed item list to the approved scope in Jira
Raise one AGILE-Exception per item committed without approval
Track each exception to resolution within 1 business day of being raised
Done when resolved within 1 business day of being raised
verify: Search AGILE-Exception tickets in Jira
Pass when none remain open past 1 business day
